preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 30.
Constraints for n, c, and q for each test case.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: len(p) == n and 1 <= p_i <= n and p_i != p_j if i != j
preconditions.description: Initial permutation p has length n with unique elements from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: for each query: 1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= 10^18
preconditions.description: Constraints for query parameters i and j.

postconditions.expression: for each query: if j-th permutation exists, output the i-th number in that permutation; otherwise, output -1
postconditions.description: Output the i-th number in the j-th permutation if it exists, otherwise -1.
